module Robot
export move, Point
struct Point{T<:Real}
    x::T
    y::T
end
Base.:+(a::Point, b::Point) = Point(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y)
function move(p::Point, cmds::AbstractString; step=1)
    for c in cmds
        c == 'A' ? (p = p + Point(0, step)) : c in ('L', 'R') ? nothing : error("bad $c")
    end
    return p
end
macro twice(ex) quote $(esc(ex)); $(esc(ex)) end end
xs = [i^2 for i in 1:3 if isodd(i)]
d = Dict("a" => 1); d["b"] = get(d, "b", 0) + 1
@twice println(xs, d)
end
